item.title: Official-source Unemployment Benefit Q&A: Turning 165 Questions into Verification Paths
item.description:
Problem: similar questions can produce different administrative outcomes

A short question such as “Can I qualify after resigning?” may depend on separation reason, insured periods, documents, job-search activity, an individual notice, and agency review. A website that decides the case can conflict with current law or the actual disposition.

The service is therefore a static verification aid, not an eligibility chatbot. It helps a user find:

  • the closest question type;
  • facts and documents to check;
  • the relevant Work24, ministry, or statute source;
  • what to confirm through an individual notice or competent employment center.

Why 165 questions become eight categories

Publishing raw conversations would expose personal context and create duplicates. One giant FAQ would make discovery difficult.

item.title: resumOpenAI: An Evidence-aware Resume Generation PoC
item.description:
Problem: controlling career facts matters more than fluent generation

resumOpenAI explores a narrower problem than “ask an LLM to write a resume.” It separates verified career facts, private fields, target-role selection, draft generation, and output validation so that polished wording cannot silently alter dates, employers, roles, or measured outcomes.

Area Design
Frontend React form and draft review
API Flask request validation and generation orchestration
Data structured career facts with evidence/status fields
LLM controlled prompt and optional adaptation path
Safety personal-data minimization and public/private separation
QA claim/date/number checks before export

Why structure comes before fine-tuning

Fine-tuning can make style more consistent, but it cannot repair missing or contradictory facts. The first quality gate is a structured source model.
